cases.name: itatiaia-optical-development

known_findings: NIR residuals are weak in the retained 24.35-hour sensor pair; do not tune a general correction to this case.
Whole-date NDVI reconstruction scored 65.37% of held-out clear cell dates.

daily_query_diagnostic.description: Same interval and gap limit, evaluated every UTC day; saved recipe/output unchanged.

coverage_notes: Coverage goal 80% was not met: 73.3% supported. All planned candidates within the scene budget were prepared; missing data remain explicit.

temporal_holdout.method: Leave one complete UTC acquisition day out, across all sensors; reconstruct using remaining clear days
temporal_holdout.baseline: Nearest admissible bracket observation, tie to earlier; paired cells and identical bracket limit
limitations: Clear satellite observations are the withheld reference, not independent ground truth. Residuals also include sensor, atmospheric and registration differences.

Scoring excludes cells without admissible training brackets. Coverage includes every held-out clear cell, including edge dates; a low error on a small scored subset does not establish reliable gap filling.
Whole-date exclusion prevents same-day sensor leakage. Cloud-free holdouts do not reproduce the distribution of genuinely cloud-obscured conditions.
Neighboring pixels are correlated. Sample counts are cell-date comparisons, not independent replicates; no confidence interval or statistical superiority is claimed.
This retrospective test uses observations before and after the held-out date. It does not validate causal forecasting, calibration, harmonization, or per-pixel uncertainty.

sensor_agreement.pairing: Greedy closest UTC timestamp within the separation limit, with common clear support; each source used at most once
sensor_agreement.scatter_sampling: Deterministic equally spaced row-major common-clear cells; metrics use all common clear cells
limitations: Agreement is not accuracy against ground truth. Real temporal change, BRDF, atmospheric correction, bandpass, point-spread function and registration differences all affect residuals.
Only native-QA-clear complete spectra on the existing common grid are compared. Cloudy areas and other dates are not represented. Shared grids do not establish image-based coregistration.

Before-local-bandpass values reverse only recorded affine coefficients on the same resampled, QA-masked cells, subject to floating-point rounding. They do not undo upstream HLS processing or reconstruct original native-grid pixels.
Pixels are spatially correlated. Counts are paired cells, not independent replicates. No statistical significance, uncertainty calibration or automatic acceptance threshold is inferred.
Closest-first disjoint matching is a bounded heuristic, not a globally optimal pairing. No scene is duplicated across accepted pairs, and insufficient clear overlap remains explicit.
